description: Make an EMAIL TEMPLATE in Klaviyo from a creative: image (any reference upload_klaviyo_image takes; it goes into the image library first) plus copy YOU write in the brand's voice (read get_brand for voice and colours): headline, body (paragraphs split by a blank line), ctaText + ctaUrl for the button, accent (#RRGGBB button colour). It is laid out as a 600px email with the unsubscribe link and sender address Klaviyo requires. Or pass html for the user's own markup (that footer is added if it has no unsubscribe link). Saves the template only, nothing is sent; returns the templateId for create_klaviyo_campaign. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).

html.description: your own full HTML instead of the layout

image.description: a Library id, Hermoso or upload_file URL, or a public image URL

name: create_klaviyo_template
title: Create a Klaviyo email template
